name: Logz.io
summary: Logz.io lists Log Management at $0.92 per ingested GB per day with 7-day retention, quoted for the AWS US East region. Extra retention is priced per day by tier. A 14-day trial is free, and subscription plans are sold by quote.

facts.text: Additional retention is priced per extra day at $0.03 for the hot tier, $0.015 for warm and $0.001 for cold.
The page describes alerts that can combine several queries and trigger conditions, with a setting for how often they fire.
Monthly billing costs 1.2 times the annual rate, and overage is billed at 1.4 times the subscription rate.

plans.name: Log Management (consumption)
plans.notes: 7-day retention, AWS US East pricing. Listed by the vendor as per ingested GB, per day, with no monthly figure
